build_retinanet_model: build a RetinaNet object detection model from a detectron2 config with backbone and head
create_retinanet_head: create a RetinaNetHead module for classification and box regression on FPN feature maps
run_retinanet_training: run RetinaNet training with focal loss classification and smooth L1 box regression losses
test_retinanet_inference: test RetinaNet inference on images using thresholding and per-class non-maximum suppression
review_retinanet_anchor_matching: review the RetinaNet label_anchors method that matches anchors to ground truth boxes using IoU
